data.key: Sorcerer Bonus Spell L3 ~ Protection from Energy
data.name: Protection from Energy
data.description: Protection from energy grants temporary immunity to the type of energy you specify when you cast it [acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic]. When the spell absorbs 12 points per caster level of energy damage [to a maximum of 120 points at 10th level], it is discharged. Protection from energy overlaps [and does not stack with] resist energy. If a character is warded by protection from energy and resist energy, the protection spell absorbs damage until its power is exhausted.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
